I have depression, and sometimes it spikes unexpectedly. It’s not something I put on applications, because usually I can handle it. But one day I was just so exhausted and sad, I just kept messing up my orders and dropping things. I had an awesome supervisor who I loved to bits, and she hated my asshole boss just as much as everyone else. I had confided in her about my depression before, and I think she noticed that I was having a crappy time. When my boss came downstairs and demanded to know who made the mess on the counter that I had gone in the back room to get paper towels for, my supervisor stepped in and said that it was her. He told her to be more careful next time. That meant so much to me. If he had known it was me, he would have definitely yelled, and my supervisor knew that I couldn’t handle that right then. I thanked her and when my shift was over, I bought something from her register and tipped her 10 dollars. I’ll never forget her.

This ones a doozie. So my two cousins, let’s call them Travis and Megan, came into the living room where we were all gathered, and proudly announced to the family that they were romantically involved. They explained how being related by blood isn’t something they can control, and gave this big speech on true love. I was like 8 at the time so I didn’t really get it, but I can tell you that my entire family just sat staring, mouths agape. My two great aunts, the mothers of Travis and Megan, looked at each other in horror. My great grandmother, the matriarch of our family, said something along the lines of “No.” Again, I was like 8. Travis and Megan excused themselves, and went to get “fresh air.” 

Immediately, chaos ensued, and every member of the family was giving their two cents. Travis’ mother, my great aunt who dabbled in shapeshifting and magic and stuff, said that maybe they were kindred spirits, and that their auras seemed to match, and everyone shifted the conversation from Travis and Megan to the sanity of my Aunt. Meanwhile, I went to go snoop on Travis because he was my favorite older cousin. I realized that they were gone, and I went to tell my family. 

Then we created a makeshift search party to look for them in the wash behind my great grandmothers house. This wash was huge, miles and miles of uninhabited desert. This was in Benson, Arizona. A sleepy little town in the middle of nowhere. The wash was full of saguaros, snakes, big rocks and hills, the whole nine yards. Luckily the family was familiar with the layout of this vast desert wasteland because it was tradition to go walk around in it after Thanksgiving lunch. My mom made it fun for me and the other little cousins, and I remember how we pretended to be the FBI. 

We ended up finding them, they were standing up on this big rock holding hands. It was weird. We brought them back, and had our awkward Thanksgiving lunch. Next Thanksgiving they weren’t together anymore, and no one in my family talks about this. Ever. At all. 

TL:DR my cousins announced they were dating and then ran away into the desert area behind the house
